description: This file defines an AgentService class for a chatbot-like system that employs various tools to perform actions based on model responses. It includes error handling, tool setup, message exchange, and core logic for executing actions and parsing responses.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for agent-related errors, including error type and optional detail message.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main service class orchestrating the agent's operation, tool setup, message exchange, error handling, and execution flow.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the agent's internal state, including message history and running status.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Processes user input, manages the agent loop, responsible for model interaction, action execution, and response parsing.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the agent's history with specified type and content.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes available tools for the agent to perform tasks like file I/O, time retrieval, and calculations.

methods.name: _tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes an expression string into a list of tokens for parsing.

methods.name: _pF
methods.description: Parses factors, handling parentheses and unary minus.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Executes a specified tool action based on parsed command.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses the arguments of an action, considering quoted strings.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content between specified XML tags from model responses.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Generates the initial system prompt including available tools for the model.
